description: DESTRUCTIVE: delete all data of the chosen services (every Firestore document, every Auth user and tenant, every Storage object, every Pub/Sub topic, subscription, schema and message, every Cloud Tasks task and its history). Clearing more than one service needs confirmProject set to the project id.

confirmProject.description: The project id, required when clearing more than one service (the console's safeguard)

runTriggers.description: Firestore only: run the delete triggers of the cleared documents; default false

name: emulators_clear
